songs.title: Stay (feat. Mikky Ekko)
songs.description: “Stay” is an emotional ballad by Rihanna featuring Mikky Ekko, released as part of her album Unapologetic. Built around a minimal piano-driven arrangement, the song explores vulnerability, longing, emotional dependence, and the uncertainty of an intense relationship. Rihanna and Mikky Ekko’s restrained vocal performances give the track an intimate and reflective atmosphere, emphasizing the conflict between wanting emotional closeness and fearing the complications that come with it.

songs.title: Send My Love (To Your New Lover)
songs.description: “Send My Love (To Your New Lover)” is an upbeat pop track by Adele from her album 25. The song explores acceptance, emotional growth, and moving forward after the end of a relationship. Rather than dwelling solely on heartbreak, it presents a confident sense of closure and freedom, reflecting the decision to let go of the past and wish a former partner well. Its energetic rhythm and expressive vocal performance give the track a lighter and more empowering character while retaining Adele’s emotionally driven songwriting style.

Walking through the city with the music in my ears
Every beat that's dropping washes away the fears
Look into the distance, colors coming alive
Feel the rhythm moving, helping our souls survive
This is the moment, this is where we belong
Singing together to our favorite song
Feel the vibration, hold on to the light
We're dancing together all through the night
Never gonna let this feeling fade away
Tomorrow is coming with a brighter day
♪ (Ocean Breeze continues) ♪
Every little melody touching the heart inside
Nothing left to lose and nothing left to hide
We made it through the storm, we reached the other side
♪ (Outro fade) ♪

songs.title: Whispering Pines
songs.description: Intimate fingerpicked acoustic guitar and natural reverb recorded in a cabin.

syncedLyrics.text: Deep into the night
With the moonlight as my guide
I go wander through the pines and make my way to nature's shrine
And I look up to the sky
And I know you're still alive
But I wonder where you are, I call your name into the dark
I wake up in the morning, oh, and I don't know where I've been
All alone on a mountainside and I'm huddled in the wind
And it feels like I've been away for an era but nothing has changed at all
And it feels like I've been with you, oh, but what did we do and where have you gone
On the night you disappeared
Oh, if I had seen it clear
But a strange light in the sky was shining right into my eyes
There was no one else in sight
Just the endless frozen pines
But I wonder all they know 'cause they don't die and they don't grow
I am ready to follow you even though I don't know where
I will wait in the night until you decide to take me there
'Cause I know I don't wanna stay here forever, it's time to be movin on
Oh I don't want to be the only one living when all of my friends are gone
I will be waiting for you, on the other side of the frozen pines
I'm gonna find a way through, there's another life beyond the line
I will be waiting for you, on the other side of the frozen pines
I'm gonna find a way through, there's another life beyond the line

en.text: Sunlight filtering through the green canopy
Pine needles softly under each stride
Finding that peace we carry inside

es.text: La luz solar se filtra por la copa de los árboles
Caminando despacio en la armonía del bosque
Agujas de pino crujen suavemente bajo cada paso
Encontrando la paz que llevamos dentro

tl.text: Sinag ng araw na tumatagos sa mga dahon
Mabagal na naglalakad sa himig ng kalikasan
Dahon ng pino sa ilalim ng bawat hakbang
Natatagpuan ang kapayapaan sa ating puso

ja.text: ♪ (温かいアコースティックの指弾き) ♪

自然の調和の中、ゆっくりと歩みを進める
一歩ごとに優しく踏みしめる松の葉
